{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in research and development expenses over the past year, scaled by total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing R&D investments may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Cash Flow Volatility", "construction": "Compute the standard deviation of quarterly cash flows from operations over the past 5 years, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with volatile cash flows may face higher risks and require higher returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Calculate the year-over-year growth rate of total employees, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing workforces may be experiencing strong demand and future growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Intangible Asset Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of intangible assets to total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high intangible asset ratios may have more growth opportunities and require higher returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign Sales Fraction", "construction": "Calculate the fraction of total sales generated from foreign operations, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high foreign sales fractions may face higher risks and require higher returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Plan Underfunding", "construction": "Compute the ratio of pension plan liabilities to assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with underfunded pension plans may face higher liabilities and require higher returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the change in capital expenditures over the past year, scaled by total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing capital expenditures may be investing in future growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expense Ratio", "construction": "Compute the ratio of advertising expenses to total sales, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high advertising expense ratios may be experiencing strong brand recognition and future growth opportunities.", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Accounts Receivable Turnover", "construction": "Calculate the ratio of total sales to average accounts receivable, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with high accounts receivable turnover may have more efficient working capital management and require lower returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Dividend Payout Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the change in dividend payouts over the past year, scaled by total assets, using Compustat data.", "rationale": "Firms with increasing dividend payouts may be signaling future cash flow generation and requiring lower returns to compensate investors.", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
